get.summary: Read separately typed objective or legacy incident-SLA history
get.description:
Requires global metrics visibility for both history sources. Scoped readers can request actor-filtered evaluations instead. source=OBJECTIVE (default) or LEGACY_INCIDENT_SLA. Signed cursors bind to the lineage and source; legacy incident-SLA evidence is not reinterpreted as objective measurements.

Requires API scope `service-objectives:read` (Service objectives read).

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time at which the window resets.

post.summary: Queue a bounded evaluation of an explicitly reviewed immutable version
post.description:
Required idempotency key; at most two active jobs per credential and sixteen globally. Periods must be ordered, not in the future, and at most 3650 elapsed days. The worker checks current scope, role and service access before computation and before storing the result. Ad-hoc actor-scoped results do not overwrite scheduled shared history. Retention-clipped or unsupported telemetry is UNAVAILABLE, never compliant.

Requires API scope `service-objectives:evaluate` (Service objectives evaluate).

patch.summary: Update reviewed status-page appearance through the canonical publication command
patch.description:
Requires a concrete If-Match configuration revision. Requires an Idempotency-Key; committed configuration metadata replays without a second audit. New keys with stale validators return 412. Publication status is read after commit and can advance on replay. Privacy narrowing withdraws the old projection before publication. A saved configuration does not imply LIVE publication. Domain claims and inline secret/provider settings are not accepted here.

Requires API scope `status-pages:write` (Status pages manage).
